appStore.promotionalText: Find your perfect match with Flamoral! Swipe, match, and connect with singles nearby. Premium features include unlimited likes and advanced filters. Join now!
appStore.description:
FIND YOUR PERFECT MATCH

Flamoral brings together singles looking for genuine connections. Whether you're seeking a serious relationship, new friends, or casual dating, Flamoral helps you discover compatible matches nearby.

SMART MATCHING
- Advanced algorithm learns your preferences
- Location-based discovery finds singles near you
- Detailed profiles with photos and interests
- Compatibility scores based on your lifestyle
- AI-powered conversation starters

SAFE & SECURE
- Photo verification for authentic profiles
- AI-powered content moderation
- Report and block unwanted users
- End-to-end encrypted messaging
- Privacy controls to protect your data
- Age verification (18+)

PREMIUM FEATURES
Upgrade to Premium for enhanced features:
- Unlimited likes and super likes
- Advanced filters (age, distance, interests)
- See who liked you before matching
- Rewind on accidental swipes
- Boost your profile for more visibility
- Browse in incognito mode
- Priority customer support

EASY TO USE
- Create your profile in minutes
- Swipe right to like, left to pass
- Match when both users like each other
- Start chatting instantly after matching
- Share photos, GIFs, and voice messages
- Video calls with your matches

REAL CONNECTIONS
- Verified profiles for authenticity
- Conversation starters to break the ice
- Profile prompts to showcase personality
- Interests and lifestyle tags
- Daily match recommendations

VIDEO PROFILES
- Create engaging video introductions
- See the real person, not just photos
- Video calling for virtual dates

WHY CHOOSE FLAMORAL?

Unlike other dating apps, Flamoral focuses on quality over quantity. Our verification system ensures real people, while our matching algorithm helps you find truly compatible partners. With built-in safety features and privacy controls, you can date with confidence.

Join thousands of singles who have found meaningful relationships through Flamoral. Download now and start your journey to finding love!

AGE REQUIREMENT
Must be 18+ to use Flamoral.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Flamoral offers optional subscription packages:
- Premium: $14.99/month or $99.99/year
- Gold: $24.99/month or $179.99/year
- Platinum: $39.99/month or $299.99/year

Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled 24 hours before the period ends. Manage subscriptions in your iTunes Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://flamoral.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://flamoral.com/terms

playStore.fullDescription:
Flamoral: Where Passion Meets Connection

Discover meaningful relationships with Flamoral, the next-generation dating app that combines authentic connections with cutting-edge AI technology.

KEY FEATURES:

VIDEO PROFILES & AUTHENTICITY
- Create engaging video profiles that showcase the real you
- AI-powered photo verification to ensure genuine profiles
- Voice messages and video calls for deeper connections
- See who people really are, not just filtered photos

INTELLIGENT MATCHING
- Advanced AI matching algorithm based on compatibility
- Smart conversation starters powered by personality insights
- Chemistry prediction to find your perfect match
- Semantic match scoring for meaningful connections

SAFE & RESPECTFUL COMMUNITY
- Comprehensive safety toolkit and reporting features
- AI-powered scam and toxicity detection
- Block and report inappropriate behavior instantly
- Age verification for user safety (18+)
- 24/7 moderation and support team

ENGAGING FEATURES
- Swipe to discover compatible matches nearby
- Advanced filters for preferences and deal-breakers
- Real-time messaging with smart reply suggestions
- Video calling for virtual dates
- Icebreakers and conversation prompts
- Daily rewards and gamification elements

PREMIUM FEATURES
- Unlimited likes and super likes
- See who liked you before matching
- Boost your profile for more visibility
- Rewind your last swipe
- Advanced filters and preferences
- Read receipts and priority support

PRIVACY FOCUSED
- End-to-end encrypted messaging
- Control who sees your profile
- Anonymous browsing mode available
- GDPR compliant data handling
- Easy account deletion anytime

RELATIONSHIP MODES
- Dating: Find your long-term partner
- Casual: Meet new people for fun connections
- Friends: Build meaningful friendships
- Networking: Professional connections

WHY FLAMORAL?

Unlike traditional dating apps that focus solely on photos, Flamoral helps you connect with compatible people through:
- AI-powered personality insights
- Video profiles that show authenticity
- Smart conversation tools to break the ice
- Safety features that protect your experience
- Gamification that makes dating fun

Whether you're looking for love, friendship, or meaningful connections, Flamoral creates a safe, engaging, and authentic experience.

JOIN THE FLAMORAL COMMUNITY

Millions of singles are already finding meaningful connections on Flamoral. Download now and start your journey to finding someone special!

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

Flamoral is free to download and use. Optional premium subscriptions unlock additional features:
- Flamoral Premium: $14.99/month
- Flamoral Gold: $24.99/month
- Flamoral Platinum: $39.99/month

Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your Google Play account settings.

MINIMUM AGE REQUIREMENT

You must be 18 years or older to use Flamoral. We take age verification seriously to maintain a safe community.

Download Flamoral today and discover where passion meets connection!
